seen.extent: A-87 ff. 256-311: about ten originals or copies in cipher of the Cardinal-Infante to Sarmiento and Saavedra Fajardo, 29 Sep 1638 - 16 Sep 1639, nearly each followed by its decipherment
seen.cipher: Only the finding aid was seen, not the leaves. It records 'Texto descifrado' bound after the cipher originals at ff. 260, 269, 277-278, 285, 297-298, 305-306 and 313 (manuscript in contemporary hand), and one letter 'con frases en cifra, descifradas al margen' (f. 319).
